fb: Your SURGO practice estimate for this Take an Interview response is 0.5 out of 5. You said, "I just want annoying," which does not answer the advisor's question about who you are or why you chose this university. Relevance and development are both too thin to support the task. On delivery, the word "annoying" was marked as a Mispronunciation, and the long "uh" filler at the start lowers fluency. Next action: before recording, write two or three short sentences that name your major, your reason for choosing the university, and one study habit you want to build, then practise reading them aloud without fillers.

这次 Take an Interview 的 SURGO 练习估分为 0.5 分（满分 5 分）。你的回答是 “I just want annoying.”，既没有介绍你自己，也没有说明选择本校的原因，因此相关性和展开都不够。发音方面，“annoying” 被判为 Mispronunciation，开头的 “uh” 停顿也让流利度下降。下一步建议：录音前先写好两三句话，至少包括专业、选择该校的原因和你想养成的一个学习习惯，然后练习不加入语气词地朗读。
questions.q: "Good morning. Thanks for coming in today. Could you start by telling me a little about yourself and why you chose to attend this university?"

The audio also showed clear pronunciation problems on words like 'simile' and on several consonants, so even the short reply was hard to hear clearly. For a SURGO practice estimate, the task score is 0.5 out of 5. Next step: re-record and directly name a class, then give one specific reason it appeals to you, for example, 'I am most interested in Introduction to Psychology because I want to understand how memory works, and the lab sessions look hands-on.'
